description: Sets the PROFINET device name of ONE interface and/or its automatic name generation. `interface` is the interface item name from tia_device_network. Pass `name` (an explicit name turns auto-generation off, so the plan lists both changes) and/or `autoGeneration`; neither: 400 missing_param; `name` together with autoGeneration:true: 400 conflicting_params. The name must be DNS-style: labels of a-z, 0-9 and '-' separated by '.', each label 1-63 octets and 240 octets in all, no label starting or ending with '-', the first label not `port-xyz` or `port-xyz-abcde`, the whole not shaped like an IPv4 address, and an upper-case letter is refused, never lowered: 400 invalid_pn_device_name (details.violations [{code,message}], details.rule). Also refused, nothing changed: 409 pn_name_in_use (another node on the same subnet has the name as its visible name or as its effective converted name, details.usedBy.matchedOn), 409 pn_names_unverifiable (the names of other nodes on the subnet could not all be read, details.unreadable), 409 node_attribute_list_unavailable (details.attributes, details.reason: the attribute list of the node could not be read, so it cannot be verified that the names can be written), 409 node_attribute_unreadable (details.attributes: the current value of the PROFINET device name or of its auto-generation could not be read, so a failed write could not be rolled back; nothing changed), 409 pn_name_unsupported (not a PROFINET interface, or an attribute the request writes is not writable; details.attributes), 400 bad_request for a blank name, 404 not_found for an unknown device or interface (details lists the interface names). Only the values that differ are written; the result carries `changes` and a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the node after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches; details.rollback says whether the previous name and auto-generation were restored, verified by a fresh read; details.restoreFailures lists every field that is NOT back at its previous value): re-read with tia_device_network. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan WITHOUT changing anything, but it cannot prove that PnDeviceName becomes writable once auto-generation is off: the real call can still be 409 pn_name_unsupported (details.reason), after which auto-generation is restored (409 conflict when that cannot be confirmed). Maps to POST /devices/{device}/pn-name. M-off.

autoGeneration.description: turn the automatic generation of the PROFINET device name on or off

device.description: device name, as listed by tia_devices

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

interface.description: interface item name, as listed by tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface)

name.description: new PROFINET device name (DNS-style, lower case)

name: tia_pn_name_set
title: TIA — set PROFINET device name
